task.description:
Set up benchmark environment so `zig build bench` exits 0.

The benchmark requires BPM_DB_URL pointing to a test PostgreSQL instance. Currently `zig build bench` fails with 'MissingDbUrl'.

Fix options:
1. Check if a PostgreSQL test container is defined in docker-compose.yml. If so, start it with `docker-compose up -d postgres` (or equivalent).
2. Export BPM_DB_URL in the terminal: `$env:BPM_DB_URL='postgresql://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test'` or similar.
3. If the existing database setup uses a different URL pattern, check docker-compose.yml for the correct credentials.

After setup, verify: `zig build bench` exits 0.
Do NOT change any bench source code — only fix the environment.

result.summary: Set up benchmark environment: started my-fab-db_test-1 PostgreSQL container on port 5433, set BPM_DB_URL and BPM_TEST_DB_URL. All NFR benchmarks passed.
